free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports sampling due to the high-risk MRI finding (PI-RADS 5 with suspected extracapsular extension) and the rapid PSA velocity of 35.73 ng/mL/yr. This is further supported by the prior positive biopsy status and the high csPCa predicted probability of 0.95889634. The statistical prior suggested deferral, but the retrieved evidence of aggressive imaging features and rapid biochemical progression decisively tipped the recommendation toward sampling.
